description: This Java source file defines the ScorecardMapper class, which provides static methods to map ScorecardData objects to Scorecard domain entities within a survey and scoring context. It handles the conversion of data transfer objects into domain objects, associating questions and responses from a survey, and setting metadata such as creation date, user, and client.

classes.name: ScorecardMapper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to map ScorecardData to Scorecard entities, linking questions and responses from a survey, and setting related metadata.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Converts ScorecardData into a list of Scorecard objects, associating each with a survey, user, and client. Throws an exception if no scorecard values are present.

methods.name: setQuestionAndResponse
methods.description: Associates a question and its response with a Scorecard object based on matching IDs from ScorecardValue and Survey questions.
